# Prompts

Prompts are ready-made starting points. In clients that support MCP prompts they appear as slash commands (for example `/mcp__gupshup__draft-message-template` in Claude Code); elsewhere, paste the example as your message.

## Analytics

| Prompt | What it does | Try asking |
|---|---|---|
| `/whatsapp-performance` | How WhatsApp is performing. | “How is my WhatsApp performing?” |
| `/sms-performance` | How SMS is performing. | “How is my SMS performing?” |
| `/rcs-performance` | How RCS is performing. | “How is my RCS performing?” |
| `/all-channels-overview` | How every channel is performing, in one view. | “How are all my channels performing? Compare them like for like and tell me which is strongest and weakest.” |
| `/compare-channels` | Compare channels side by side. | “Compare my channels over the same period and tell me which is working best for me.” |
| `/delivery-health` | Where messages are failing, and why. | “Where am I losing delivery, and why? Rank the causes and tell me the highest-impact fix.” |
| `/unreachable-numbers` | Contacts that cannot be reached on a channel. | “How many of my contacts could not be reached, and what did those attempts cost me?” |
| `/template-performance` | Which templates perform best and worst. | “Which of my templates perform best and worst? Show me what the weak one would have achieved at the winner's rate.” |
| `/template-clicks` | Button click performance for a template. | “How are the buttons on my WhatsApp template performing?” |
| `/spend-breakdown` | Messaging spend by channel. | “What am I spending, by channel? Include my cost per delivered and per read message.” |
| `/cost-efficiency` | Which channel gives the best value. | “Which channel gives me the best value, and where should I shift more volume?” |
| `/campaign-performance` | How campaigns performed. | “How did my campaigns perform, and which one did best?” |
| `/account-health` | Quality rating, tier and sending limits. | “What is my quality rating, messaging tier and sending limit, and what do they mean for how much I can send?” |
| `/period-comparison` | This period versus the last one. | “Compare this period against the previous one and lead with the biggest change.” |
| `/growth-opportunities` | The biggest opportunities to improve results. | “Where are my biggest opportunities to get more from my messaging? Rank them by impact with the numbers behind each.” |

## Templates

| Prompt | What it does | Try asking |
|---|---|---|
| `/draft-message-template` | Draft a new message template and see it previewed. | “Help me draft a new whatsapp message template. Show me a preview.” |
| `/create-message-flow` | Design a multi-step message sequence with timing. | “Help me design a multi-step message sequence. Show me the timeline.” |
| `/ab-test-message-variants` | Create variants of a message to test. | “Create 2 whatsapp message variants for me to test. Show me each one.” |
| `/improve-template-copy` | Rewrite a message to work better. | “Help me improve one of my whatsapp message templates for clarity and engagement. Show me the result next to the original.” |
| `/localize-template` | Adapt a message into another language. | “Help me adapt one of my whatsapp templates into another language. Show me the result.” |
| `/review-template-library` | Review your templates and spot gaps. | “Review my whatsapp templates: what I have, their status, and where the gaps are.” |
| `/submit-template-for-approval` | Submit a template for approval. | “Submit my whatsapp template for approval.” |
| `/check-template-approval` | Check whether a template is approved yet. | “Which of my templates are approved, and which are still pending?” |
| `/fix-rejected-template` | Fix a rejected template and resubmit it. | “One of my templates was rejected. Tell me why, fix it, and resubmit it.” |

## Campaigns

| Prompt | What it does | Try asking |
|---|---|---|
| `/send-campaign` | Send a campaign end to end. | “I want to send a campaign on WhatsApp, RCS, or SMS.” |
| `/ab-test-campaign` | Run an A/B test between two messages. | “I want to run an A/B test with 2 message variants.” |
| `/multilingual-campaign` | Send the same campaign in several languages. | “I want to send a campaign with different copy for each language.” |
| `/follow-up-nudges` | Add timed follow-ups for people who do not reply. | “I want to add timed follow-up nudges for people who do not reply, each with its own message.” |
| `/schedule-campaign` | Schedule a campaign for later. | “I want to schedule a campaign to go out later.” |
| `/build-audience` | Build or inspect a campaign audience. | “Help me build an audience for a campaign. Target source: cdp.” |
| `/cdp-segmentation` | Build a segment from your customer data. | “Help me build and preview a segment of my customers.” |
| `/crm-audience-pull` | Target contacts from your CRM. | “I want to target contacts from my CRM.” |
| `/audience-reach` | Check how many people you can actually reach. | “How many contacts can I actually reach for this audience, by channel, before I spend anything?” |
| `/campaign-results` | See how a campaign performed. | “Show me how my campaign performed.” |
| `/list-campaigns` | List recent campaigns and their results. | “List my campaigns from the last 30 days with their results.” |
| `/optimize-live-campaign` | Health-check and tune a running campaign. | “Health-check my running campaign and tell me what to tune.” |
| `/account-health-check` | Check you are ready to send. | “Am I ready to send? Check my quality, limits and opt-in status.” |
| `/billing-and-usage` | See what you have used and spent. | “Show my messaging usage and spend for the last 30 days.” |

## Interactive review panels

Panels are MCP Apps (`ui://` resources) that render inside clients that support them. Clients without MCP Apps support get the same information as text, and launches still require confirmation.

| Panel | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `ui://meta-templates/preview` | Renders template previews in Super Agent chat (MCP App). |
| `ui://gupshup-cpaas/campaign-segments-review` | MCP App carousel panel for campaign pre-flight review — rendered by open_campaign_review. |
| `ui://gupshup-cpaas/ab-review` | MCP App HTML panel for A/B test pre-flight review — rendered when open_ab_test_review runs. |
| `ui://gupshup-cpaas/language-review` | MCP App HTML panel for language personalization review — rendered when open_language_review runs. |
